analysis.purpose: The test suite for trusted-ref — it defines the behaviour that is guaranteed, so a change that breaks any of it fails the build. It pins: deriveTeamTrust; runMemoryCheck — exact merged records become team-trusted (invariant #4); runMemoryCheck — branch-only memory is not team-trusted (invariant #3); runMemoryCheck — an agent cannot self-assert a pass (invariant #2).
responsibilities: Pin the observable behaviour of trusted-ref
Fail the build when a guaranteed behaviour changes
